title: [01/04/2023] - The ground floor of a particular building
prompt: The plans below show how the ground of a particular building has changed over time. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the layout changes of a building's ground floor across three distinct time periods: 1958-1984, 1985-2000, and 2001 to the present.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the building underwent complete functional transformations, evolving from an office space to residential accommodation, and finally to a commercial flower shop, with significant modifications to the internal layout and room purposes throughout the periods.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: During the first transformation from the office period (1958-1984) to the apartment period (1985-2000), the kitchen was retained in its original position. The original manager's office and reception area were reconfigured to accommodate two separate bedrooms. Additionally, the meeting room and assistant's office were combined and converted into a spacious living room. Finally, the secretary's office and toilet were merged and transformed into a bathroom and shower area, creating a more functional residential layout.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In the subsequent period from the apartment phase (1985-2000) to the flower shop era (2001-present), the kitchen remained unchanged, demonstrating its consistent utility across all three phases. However, the living room and bathroom were demolished and replaced by designated areas for gift cards and a play area, with a flower display section positioned between these two spaces. Meanwhile, the two bedrooms were completely replaced by an office and additional flower display area, effectively converting the residential space into a commercial flower retail environment.
